captions.caption: A man in a green jacket is kneeling outdoors, opening a blue container with bacon inside.
The man shows the contents of the container, including an egg and bacon strips.
He picks up the small container holding the egg.
He places the small egg container back into the blue box.
He points to the bacon while explaining his breakfast plan.
The man continues to talk about the bacon and egg.
He gestures towards the fire pit in front of him.
He puts the blue lid back on the container.
He reaches for a small metal camping pot.
He opens the metal pot to prepare for cooking.
He takes a small plastic bag out of the metal pot.
A dog's head is visible on the left side of the frame.
The man talks to the dog while holding the egg container.
He prepares to crack the egg into the small metal pot.
The man cracks the egg and pours it into the metal pot.
He sets the empty eggshell aside on the ground.
He reaches for a green water bottle nearby.
He picks up the green water bottle to add water to the pot.
He opens the cap of the green water bottle.
He begins pouring water into a metal cup.
He continues to pour water from the green bottle.
He stops pouring and starts to close the bottle.
He places the bottle back on the ground.
He picks up the metal pot containing the egg.
He pours the egg from the pot into the metal cup.
He puts the lid on the metal cup.
He prepares to place the cup on the fire.
He stands up to approach the fire pit.
He places the metal cup on the grill over the fire.
He adjusts the cup's position on the grill.
He steps back and looks at the fire.
He explains that the egg will cook first.
He reaches for the blue container again.
He opens the container to get the bacon strips.
He picks up a strip of bacon.
He places the first strip of bacon on the grill.
He places a second strip of bacon on the grill.
He adds a third strip of bacon to the grill.
He continues placing bacon strips on the grill.
He adds the final strip of bacon to the grill.
Smoke rises as the bacon starts to cook.
He watches the bacon sizzle on the grill.
He moves the bacon slightly with his fingers.
He continues to monitor the cooking process.
Smoke from the fire drifts across the scene.
He picks up a piece of wood near the fire.
He adds the wood to the fire to keep it burning.
He looks at the bacon strips on the grill.
The bacon continues to cook over the hot coals.
He reaches for the metal cup to check the egg.
He lifts the lid of the metal cup.
He peers inside the cup to see the progress.
He replaces the lid on the metal cup.
He uses his fingers to flip a piece of bacon.
He flips another piece of bacon on the grill.
He continues flipping the bacon strips.
The bacon is becoming brown and crispy.
He adjusts the bacon's position for even cooking.
He watches the bacon carefully as it cooks.
He observes the breakfast cooking on the open fire.
